s.note: Owen building his cabin by hand
s.how: Cook 2 sliced onions slowly with a spoon of brown sugar for 30 minutes until jammy. Grill 8 thick beef sausages over coals until blistered and cooked through. Slice thickly, spear on toothpicks and serve with the onions and wholegrain mustard.

s.note: the secret cloning lab under Lockwood Manor
s.how: Boil 6 eggs for 6 minutes, cool and peel. Wrap each in about 80g sausage meat, 500g in total, roll in flour, 1 beaten egg and breadcrumbs. Deep fry at 170C for 6 minutes, or bake at 200C for 25 minutes, then halve to serve.

m.note: the rescue team heading into the jungle
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in lime juice, crushed garlic, chopped red chilli and salt for an hour. Grill until charred and cooked through. Serve with steamed long grain rice and a can of black beans warmed with a little cumin.

w.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk 3 eggs and 3 yolks with 80g sugar until thick, fold in the chocolate and 50g flour. Pour into greased moulds and bake at 200C for 10 minutes. Turn out and spoon over blended raspberries.

d.how: Fill glasses with crushed ice. Pour in cold lemonade and add a drop of blue food colouring to each, stirring until bright blue. Squeeze in a wedge of lime and serve straight away. Name it after the cleverest raptor on the island.
